summary: Transcript work rows keep the host's semantic tool kind (read, search, run, change, subagent, web, decision, todo, wait, message, schedule, terminal input, skill, eval) as data-tool-kind, with scoped targets: a run shows its readable command's first nonempty line before cwd, a search shows its term within its path, a delegation its task names. Orphan results stay unclassified. Recorded semantic results without text remain inspectable behind the existing raw input/output disclosure; skipped calls read Skipped without failure ink, and settled summaries count sent messages.

compatibility.detail: No wire change. fractal-ui WorkKind renames edit to change and adds the semantic kinds above plus unknown; kindFor receives the native tool item as an optional second argument. ToolCall items and results accept optional view, metadata and skipped facts; WorkLogCall adds optional toolName, callId, input, mediaType and skipped; WorkLogTurn adds messagesSent. Hosts that return edit must return change.
